name: Jellio
description:
This plugin provides integration between Jellyfin and the Jellio service.
Community-maintained fork with Jellyfin 10.11.x support.

versions.changelog:
## Summary
- create a fallback Jellyfin addon session when the settings page has no stored token
- return empty server info results without leaving the plugin config page stuck loading

## Summary
- fix the Jellyfin plugin setup page redirect so it works from real `/web/...` routes
- show a visible loading message instead of a blank black page while Jellio settings initialize

## Summary
- add HLS-based Stremio playback streams for better seeking and playback handling
- expose audio-language variants and subtitle metadata from Jellyfin media sources
- initialize metadata branch so Jellyfin repository manifest can be published
